decision: Use shared command metadata and main execution through existing intents
why: Main owns live focus and private-window context; avoid stale renderer commands

decision: Captured production baseline on disposable profiles
why: Measure actual artifact before visual and keyboard changes

decision: Use adblock-rs (Brave Rust N-API) + tldts over @ghostery/adblocker
why: 3.2x faster compile (61.2ms vs 196.8ms), 6.2x faster warm deser (1.8ms vs 11.4ms), 0 MB V8 heap, MPL-2.0 license

decision: Use default author origin insertCSS instead of cssOrigin user
why: Empirical Electron 36.9.5 test showed removeInsertedCSS ignores cssOrigin user keys; default origin + !important unmounts cleanly

decision: Remove ruleCount from tierSignature and cache counts sidecar
why: Avoided cold/warm cache key mismatch; warm Shields init dropped from 81.69ms to 3.88ms (~21x speedup)
